about.title: Award-Winning South Indian Vegetarian Restaurant Amersham
paragraphs: Welcome to Veg Chennai SriLalitha (VCS) Amersham, the premier destination for authentic, traditional South Indian vegetarian and vegan cuisine in Buckinghamshire.

Rooted in centuries-old recipes from Chennai, our master chefs grind our batter fresh daily using stone grinders and prepare every sambar, rasam, and chutney from scratch using hand-roasted spices and cold-pressed sesame oil.
Whether you are craving a paper-thin crispy ghee roast dosa, a rich paneer butter masala, or an elaborate royal thali, we offer a warm, family-friendly atmosphere that makes every meal a celebration.

items.name: Masala Dosa
items.description: Crispy golden fermented crepe stuffed with spiced potato masala, served with 3 signature chutneys & hot lentil sambar.

items.name: Paneer Tikka
items.description: Char-grilled fresh cottage cheese cubes marinated in Kashmiri chili, hung yogurt & roasted spices.

items.name: Idli Vada Combo
items.description: Pillowy steamed rice cakes and golden crunchy medu vada served with piping hot vegetable sambar & fresh coconut chutney.

items.name: Royal South Indian Thali
items.description: An imperial platter featuring 2 vegetable curries, kootu, dal, rasam, hot sambar, poori, fragrant basmati rice & traditional sweet.

items.name: Madras Filter Coffee
items.description: Freshly brewed chicory-infused decoction frothed with rich hot milk, served in a traditional brass dabarah and tumbler.

faqs.a: Answer to the question goes here.

faqs.q: Where is Veg Chennai SriLalitha Amersham located?
faqs.a: We are located at 94 Sycamore Rd, Amersham HP6 5EN, United Kingdom in the heart of Amersham town centre.

faqs.q: Is parking available at your location?
faqs.a: Yes, there is convenient street parking along Sycamore Road as well as multiple public car parks within a short 2-minute stroll.

faqs.q: Do you offer vegan, Jain, and gluten-free options?
faqs.a: Absolutely! Our kitchen is 100% vegetarian. All our dosas and idlis are naturally gluten-free fermented rice-lentil batters, and we have extensive vegan items. Jain dietary requirements (no root vegetables, onion, or garlic) are happily accommodated upon request.

faqs.q: Can I order food for takeaway and home delivery?
faqs.a: Yes! You can order online directly via Just Eat, Deliveroo, and Uber Eats for quick doorstep delivery, or call us on 0149 497 2550 for takeaway collection.

faqs.q: Do you offer live dosa counters and outdoor catering?
faqs.a: Yes! We specialize in live on-site dosa catering with commercial griddles and chefs, as well as full buffet catering for weddings, birthdays, and corporate events across Buckinghamshire, London, and Berkshire.

faqs.q: Do you take reservations for large groups?
faqs.a: Yes, we gladly welcome group dining. Please call us in advance on 0149 497 2550 to reserve a table for your family or party.
